name: Fate Trigger [Season2]
desc:
🎮 Dive into a fast-paced FPS arena where every kill unleashes op random buffs, turning you into an unstoppable god!

🎯 Gameplay:
- One Hit KO System - No health bars, just pure skill
- Random Buff Drops - Super speed, reload bonuses, shields & more
- Instant Respawn - Jump back immediately with all buffs intact

💪 Why You'll Love It:
- Easy to Pick Up - Start in seconds, master for a lifetime
- Intense Action - 5-minute sessions packed with hours of fun
- Fair Competition - Only cosmetic progression, no pay-to-win

Control:
M1: Fire
M2: Aim
Q: Switch Weapon
F: Inspect Weapon
M: Back to Lobby
